Витамин C.about: Antioxidant and cofactor: collagen, immunity, iron absorption.
Витамин C.caution: For ARI: prevention does NOT reduce the incidence in the general population (RR 0.96), BUT in extreme stress (marathon/skiing/army) it reduces by 50%. Therapy after symptoms begin does NOT work. For CVD: large RCTs showed no benefit. >2000 mg/day: GI side effects, risk of oxalate stones.
Витамин C.food_sources: Bell pepper, black currant, kiwi, citrus fruits, sauerkraut.
Витамин C.guidelines: EFSA: immunity and collagen; Cochrane: The common cold is slightly shorter lasting, but not less common in the general population.
Витамин C.how_to_choose: Regular ascorbic acid is sufficient; “liposomal and esterified” is an overpayment without strong data.

interactions.note: high doses may reduce the effect

mechs: Antioxidant protection of the immune system under extreme stress
Colds are half as common among marathon runners, skiers and military personnel (RR 0.50)
Antioxidant pathways in primary prevention of cardiovascular diseases
Витамин C.myths: “Prevents colds” - not in the general population. “Megadoses are safe” - GI and stones.
Витамин C.name: Vitamin C
Витамин C.onset: Subjectively no; in case of deficiency (gums, fatigue) - 1-2 weeks of replenishment.
Витамин C.title: Vitamin C
Витамин C.upper_limit: 2000 mg/day; higher - diarrhea and the risk of kidney stones in predisposed people.
Витамин C.who_needs: Smokers (+35 mg/day), few vegetables and fruits, extreme loads.
